participation.context: Read the leaf as texture, and did not copy it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the open book, unread onto the sheet

story.body: You set the feast-leaf where you could see it, and you did not take a line away. The bluebottle stayed at the glass.

relations.note: the open book, unread onto the sheet

title: Opened the book at the feast

participation.context: Wrote the opening, and the note above it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set the two lines down, and the servants above them as a note for a later afternoon. The hand and the shrine are the start of the sonnet, not the whole of it yet.

title: Wrote the opening and the servants above it

participation.context: Broke the second opening, and kept her line.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: a Nurse he will speak later, not this morning

story.body: You let the Nurse cut the quatrain, and you left her interruption as the readable part. The lines under the stroke do not survive.

relations.note: a Nurse he will speak later, not this morning

title: Let the Nurse break the second quatrain

participation.context: Spoke both tries, and kept one line.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: a voice used, and the boy not present

story.body: You spoke the short answer in a boy's voice that was not in the room, and the boy's answer in a hush you did not write down. You laughed, and you told him not to hear it.

relations.note: a voice used, and the boy not present

title: Tried the short answer in Nick's voice

story.body: You looked at the opening and at her short line, and you did not write the boy's answer under either. Monday can find it as it is.

title: Left the opening and the short answer on the sheet
